title: promote-release.mjs --rollback: every recorded prior latest must be semver-less than the release
description: Paired with lore-cli LCLI-617, 2026-09-27, and landed together AFTER the 0.11.0 pair ships so the two verdicts stay identical. Not a 0.11.0 blocker: it needs a hand-edited record plus an operator running --rollback. The hole left after QCLI-390: a record whose priorLatest is NEWER than its version, e.g. "5.7.0" in a 5.6.7 record. It passes strict X.Y.Z and != record.version, and it passes checkRollbackState while latest still reads 5.6.7. So an ungated --rollback moves latest onto a version no receipt qualified. Rule, agreed with lore-cli: every priorLatest must compare semver-less than record.version. Promotion never moves latest backwards, so a legitimate record always satisfies it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: validateRecord refuses a priorLatest that is equal to or semver-greater than record.version, comparing major, minor and patch numerically so that 0.10.0 is greater than 0.9.0
Tests cover greater, equal, lesser and a numeric-not-lexical case, and a mutation control shows they fail without the rule
Lands in the same window as lore-cli LCLI-617, citing its SHA, and the two rules are confirmed identical

implementationNotes: HANDOFF 2026-09-28 (session recycle, at orchestrator 62fc8636 direction). Left In Progress on purpose. WAITING ON lore-cli only: its LCLI-617 PR head SHA, which will come from a fresh lore-cli session after its LCLI-622 lands. WHERE: opum-ai/quest-cli#353, branch feat/QCLI-391-prior-latest-less-than, OPEN and HELD. Code head cf01bf9 is green on source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check. This note adds a tracker-only commit on top, so re-read the required contexts on the new head before merging. RULE, agreed with lore-cli (relayed by the orchestrator, not yet read from lore code): (R1) record.version must be plain X.Y.Z, else one problem and no comparison. (R2) after the existing string / X.Y.Z / equal checks, refuse a prior that compareReleaseVersions puts ABOVE record.version. (R3) the comparator compares each component by length, then lexically. The orchestrator ruled that IDENTICAL means identical VERDICTS: the same accept/refuse on every input, while refusal wording may differ per repository. If lore declines R1, drop R1 from #353 rather than diverge (orchestrator). LANDING, agreed: each side opens a PR; we swap head SHAs; each reads the other rule BY REF at that head in lore scripts/promote-latest.mjs validateRecord and confirms identical verdicts, checking greater, equal, lesser, 0.9.0 vs 0.10.0, a component past 2^53, and a malformed record.version; then both merge. Then a tracker note on each record cites BOTH merge SHAs, AC3 is ticked, and the task is closed. Reply to opum-agent when #353 lands. Address lore by ref if the bare name is ambiguous (two lore-cli sessions were listed this session).

2026-09-28, successor session. R1 now checks typeof record.version === "string" before STRICT_SEMVER.test, adopting lore-cli's check from LCLI-617, at code commit 4a08933. Before the fix, the new test (a non-string version: ["9.9.9"], 999, and an object whose toString is "9.9.9") FAILED with "TypeError: b.split is not a function" at compareReleaseVersions. That is the throw lore-cli reported. After the fix, each case gets one R1 problem, test/qcli390-promote-rollback-hardening.test.ts is 11/0, and bun run check is 850/0 (exit 0). NEXT: send lore-cli this branch's new head for the by-ref cross-read against lore-cli#354 at ac561c3. Both sides merge once each confirms identical verdicts, and then AC3 is ticked, citing both merge SHAs.
